track.title: Segah
track.notes: Tagged title: Segah. Same performance as 'The Masters of Persian Traditional Music, Sehtar' (1991) track 1; that transfer runs 0.55% slower (onset alignment), about 9 cents lower if the speed carries the pitch.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on Dk in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:10.2) introduces F, Gk, Ak, A, centred on Dk. Phrase 20 (3:16.7) introduces Ab, centred on F. The line peaks at Bb4 (492.7 Hz) at 8:19.1. It closes on the tonic (Dk4 → Dk4 → F4 → Eb4 → Dk4 → Dk3).
